title: Passage planning for a sailing yacht, step by step
lead: Most of a good day at sea is decided the evening before, at the chart table. This guide covers the four stages of a passage plan, from gathering information to checking your progress under way, with a worked example on the Turkish coast.
description: How to plan a yacht passage: charts and pilot books, route and waypoints, clearing bearings, timing for daylight and the meltemi, bolt holes and the hourly log.
summary: Gather information, plan, execute, then monitor.
Estimate time at 5 to 6 knots and arrive in daylight.
Choose a bolt hole and a decision point for every stretch.
Write the plan down and leave it with someone ashore.
